move_validation.rules: Coordinates validated via packages/contracts/realtime.js:validateCommand and validateMove (integer b: 0..8, c: 0..8); move legality applied by game.apply
move_validation.rejections: Out-of-range, negative, non-integer, and missing coordinates rejected with INVALID_MOVE before database transaction

deduplication_before_stale_revision.mechanism: Operation deduplication via Authority.move / core.run checks m.commands.has(key) BEFORE m.revision !== revision check
deduplication_before_stale_revision.lost_response_retry: Sending identical command with same operation_id and old expected_revision returns prior ack and prior snapshot without STALE_REVISION error; state unchanged

altered_payload_reuse_conflict.mechanism: Same operation_id with altered move payload detects fingerprint mismatch and throws IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
altered_payload_reuse_conflict.rollback: Complete PostgreSQL transaction rollback: board state, revision, move outcomes, outcome rows, and outbox rows remain byte-identical

stale_revision_rejection.mechanism: Fresh operation_id with expected_revision < current revision rejected with STALE_REVISION, writes nothing

turn_and_rules_enforcement.turn_order: Moving out of turn throws NOT_YOUR_TURN and commits nothing
turn_and_rules_enforcement.occupied_cell: Occupied cell throws INVALID_MOVE (engine ILLEGAL_MOVE normalized to contract code)
turn_and_rules_enforcement.match_closed: Move on settled/finished match throws MATCH_CLOSED
turn_and_rules_enforcement.resignation: Resign command settles match, sets status FINISHED, emits receipt, releases escrow, and broadcasts terminal snapshot

atomic_commit_and_broadcast.transaction_scope: State transition, command outcome in economy.command_outcomes, move outcome in match.move_outcomes, and ops.outbox event commit in ONE PostgreSQL transaction
atomic_commit_and_broadcast.ack_and_fanout: Sender receives ack with ack_revision; all connections subscribed to match_id receive snapshot with updated state
